name: Effective Range / Monotonic co-VC Dimension
proof: Every subfamily $\mathcal G$ has $\mathrm{coVC}(\mathcal G)\le\mathrm E(\mathcal G)\le\mathrm E(\mathcal H)$. Maximizing over $\mathcal G\subseteq\mathcal H$ proves the bound.
witness_verification: For #classes/trivial_concepts with n>=4, the established endpoint values or bounds, in parameter order, are $n$ and $2$. The first parameter divided by one plus the second tends to infinity. Thus no reverse affine-linear bound holds. See the database-owned endpoint value proofs.
